news.headline: Brent crude extends gains as supply risk returns to focus
news.summary: Energy prices moved higher overnight as traders priced fresh supply risk, raising pressure on oil-importing markets.
news.takeaway: Crude is the clearest macro headwind in the morning stack.
news.whyItMatters: India imports most of its crude requirement, so a fast move in Brent can pressure inflation expectations, the rupee, and downstream margins.
news.indiaImpact: Negative for oil marketing, paints, aviation, and rate-sensitive sentiment; supportive for upstream energy names.
news.watchFor: Whether Brent holds above the prior session range after Europe opens.

news.headline: Dollar and yields stay firm as traders wait for inflation cues
news.summary: The Dollar Index and treasury yields held higher, keeping financial conditions tight for emerging-market assets.
news.takeaway: The dollar-yield combination is not giving risk assets an easy tailwind.
news.whyItMatters: A firm dollar can reduce foreign investor appetite for Indian equities and raises the bar for sustained index follow-through.
news.indiaImpact: Watch IT exporters for currency sensitivity, but broader equity multiples may face pressure if yields keep rising.
news.watchFor: DXY direction near the US open and whether USD/INR reacts in the first hour.

news.headline: Nasdaq slips as yields firm before key inflation print
news.summary: US technology shares closed lower while treasury yields edged up, weakening the risk appetite setup for Asia.
news.takeaway: The US close is not a panic signal, but it removes the easy gap-up argument for Indian equities.
news.whyItMatters: Nifty often takes its first cue from US risk appetite, especially when technology, rates, and the dollar move together.
news.indiaImpact: Nifty IT and high-duration growth pockets need confirmation before any bounce is trusted.
news.watchFor: Whether Nasdaq futures stabilize before the Indian opening range breaks.

news.headline: Foreign flows remain selective as traders reduce overnight risk
news.summary: Foreign investor positioning stayed cautious, with market breadth dependent on domestic institutions and stock-specific triggers.
news.takeaway: Flow quality matters more than the headline index move today.
news.whyItMatters: A market can open firm and still fade if foreign flows do not support breadth beyond the first hour.
news.indiaImpact: Large-cap banks and defensives can hold the index together, while midcaps may need stronger breadth confirmation.
news.watchFor: Advance-decline ratio and FII-sensitive heavyweights after 10:15 AM IST.

news.headline: Private banks show relative strength as credit growth stays firm
news.summary: Domestic banking indicators remained resilient, giving Bank Nifty a possible cushion against weak global cues.
news.takeaway: Bank Nifty is the main domestic stabilizer in an otherwise mixed global setup.
news.whyItMatters: Banks carry high index weight, so resilience here can soften the impact of weak global cues on the headline Nifty.
news.indiaImpact: Private banks and select financials remain the first place to check for institutional support.
news.watchFor: Whether Bank Nifty sustains above VWAP after the opening volatility cools.

news.headline: Asian indices trade mixed as traders wait for central bank commentary
news.summary: Regional markets traded without clear direction, pointing to a volatile but selective start for Indian equities.
news.takeaway: Asia is not giving one clean directional message.
news.whyItMatters: Mixed regional breadth usually makes the Indian open more level-driven than news-driven.
news.indiaImpact: Avoid chasing the first candle; let Nifty and Bank Nifty prove acceptance near the scanner levels.
news.watchFor: Hong Kong and Japan breadth into the Indian first hour.

news.headline: China policy expectations support select Asian cyclicals
news.summary: China-linked assets saw selective interest as traders looked for incremental policy support and better commodity demand signals.
news.takeaway: China is a partial offset, not a broad risk-on confirmation.
news.whyItMatters: A stabilizing China narrative can help metals and select cyclicals even when global risk appetite is muted.
news.indiaImpact: Metals may attract tactical interest, but confirmation depends on Asian breadth and commodity follow-through.
news.watchFor: Shanghai Composite trend and base-metal reaction during the morning session.

news.headline: Defensive sectors stay in focus as volatility remains elevated
news.summary: Domestic traders continued to prefer quality banks, consumption, and defensive pockets while waiting for stronger global confirmation.
news.takeaway: The market is rewarding selectivity over broad beta.
news.whyItMatters: When macro cues are mixed, leadership quality matters more than the absolute index open.
news.indiaImpact: Banks, consumption, and defensives can outperform if crude and yields keep pressure on the broader market.
news.watchFor: Sector rotation after the first 30 minutes and whether midcap breadth confirms.
